rows.failed_witness: The first whole activation-packet display exceeded the visible result boundary before EOF.
rows.passing_bounded_witness: All 478 lines were read and the exact Git-blob digest and word count matched.
rows.recovery: Measure the committed packet and read numbered literal windows through line 478 and EOF.
rows.recurrence_guard: Measure large committed packets before display and use one bounded window per read.

rows.failed_witness: The first complete authorization-state display exceeded its output budget before EOF.
rows.passing_bounded_witness: Every state line and the required schema were read without mutation.
rows.recovery: Read the immutable state in numbered literal windows through line 1556 and EOF.
rows.recurrence_guard: Read large mutable-state snapshots in premeasured windows rather than one projection.

rows.failed_witness: The first closeout-skill display exceeded the model-visible context boundary.
rows.passing_bounded_witness: Both chunks completed and included the current owner-delta closeout override.
rows.recovery: Read the 177-line skill in two numbered chunks through EOF.
rows.recurrence_guard: Premeasure long skills and split them before the first display.

rows.failed_witness: The first orchestration-memory display omitted a bounded middle region when its result was truncated.
rows.passing_bounded_witness: The recovered interval closed the only omission through EOF.
rows.recovery: Reread the exact omitted line interval separately after the surrounding chunks.
rows.recurrence_guard: Treat a tool truncation marker as an omission gate even when later lines remain visible.

rows.failed_witness: The first byte-level packet word counter over-escaped its whitespace expression and reported zero words.
rows.passing_bounded_witness: The recovered projection reported 15,251 words and the expected SHA-256.
rows.recovery: Decode the exact Git blob as UTF-8 and count split tokens directly.
rows.recurrence_guard: Prefer decoded split counting over nested shell-regex escaping.

rows.failed_witness: A multiline Python manifest-schema wrapper returned no attributable output.
rows.passing_bounded_witness: Five manifest schemas and their 725 aggregate entries were attributed exactly.
rows.recovery: Use PowerShell scalar JSON reads to inspect each manifest's keys, entry count, and self exclusions.
rows.recurrence_guard: Avoid multiline code in a shell argument when a scalar JSON projection is sufficient.

rows.failed_witness: The first one-process-per-entry manifest replay completed its display window without an attributable result.
rows.passing_bounded_witness: The later bounded batch replay checked all 725 entries with zero mismatches.
rows.recovery: Replace per-entry Git process creation with one exact cat-file batch projection.
rows.recurrence_guard: Use one batch Git object process for large commit-local manifest replays.

rows.failed_witness: A second per-entry replay wrapper outlived its display window without preserving its terminal session identifier.
rows.passing_bounded_witness: The replacement emitted a complete per-domain replay receipt.
rows.recovery: Abandon the un-attributable wrapper and use an explicit batch result object with captured session state.
rows.recurrence_guard: Print the whole terminal result object whenever a command may cross the initial yield window.

rows.failed_witness: The first Git batch replay wrote all requests before draining stdout and deadlocked on bounded pipe buffers.
rows.passing_bounded_witness: The recovered batch replayed 725 entries with zero mismatches.
rows.recovery: Terminate only the stuck read-only process and use subprocess communication that drains output while supplying input.
rows.recurrence_guard: Use communicate or equivalent concurrent pipe drainage for Git batch protocols.

rows.failed_witness: The dynamically advertised source-task read surface reported that it was no longer callable through dynamic tools.
rows.passing_bounded_witness: The exact receipt was found and its SHA-256 matched the live baton.
rows.recovery: Use the exact local source-task rollout record read-only to recover the already-declared external receipt pointer.
rows.recurrence_guard: Treat advertised-but-retired task tools as capability failures and use current Codex MCP only when exposed.

rows.failed_witness: The first canonical-receipt projection exceeded PowerShell's default JSON depth and emitted null scalar guesses.
rows.passing_bounded_witness: The raw receipt confirmed 33 of 33 checks, 18 of 18 tests, one success, and no replay.
rows.recovery: Read the small receipt raw after its exact file hash had already matched.
rows.recurrence_guard: Inspect actual receipt keys or increase JSON depth before selecting nested fields.

rows.failed_witness: A broad worktree-registration inventory exceeded its bounded window and left two read-only Git processes running.
rows.passing_bounded_witness: All four scalar uniqueness checks proved the Ilyra lane absent before creation.
rows.recovery: Terminate only those two inventory processes and test the exact intended path, ref, registration directory, and remote ref.
rows.recurrence_guard: Never enumerate the complete worktree bank when one exact registration path answers the gate.

rows.failed_witness: The first sparse-setup diagnostic used a semicolon inside a PowerShell parenthesized expression and failed to parse before Git ran.
rows.passing_bounded_witness: The unique sparse lane materialized zero inherited files and remained clean at the exact source head.
rows.recovery: Split sparse initialization, pattern selection, read-tree population, and diagnostics into scalar commands.
rows.recurrence_guard: Assign command exit codes after invocation rather than embedding command lists inside expressions.

rows.failed_witness: The first official-source search result projection emitted no visible text because its response envelope was misread.
rows.passing_bounded_witness: Official buildingSMART, W3C, and New Zealand Building Performance sources were recovered.
rows.recovery: Project the same bounded official search response directly.
rows.recurrence_guard: Project web search responses directly unless a typed content envelope has been verified first.

rows.failed_witness: The first large two-file edit result exceeded the model-visible context and left patch application ambiguous.
rows.passing_bounded_witness: The planning builder and test rewrite were present, internally aligned, and the lane still contained only the two intended untracked files.
rows.recovery: Inspect both exact literal files and their targeted old-label, count, anchor, and route patterns before any subsequent edit.
rows.recurrence_guard: Split large patches into bounded files or sections and inspect exact post-edit state whenever tool output truncates.

rows.failed_witness: The first x1 build assumed inherited outcome rows used observed_outcome and stopped on a missing-key error before packet materialization.
rows.passing_bounded_witness: Both immutable ledgers exposed the same proposal_id, title, outcome, and completion_credit schema before the correction.
rows.recovery: Inspect the first exact Git-blob row in both predecessor ledgers and use their actual outcome field.
rows.recurrence_guard: Project exact committed ledger keys before adapting a historical builder to a newer phase.
